name: Koshimizu Yoshimitsu
source:
Koshimizu is a federal investigator and member of the Heinous Crimes Unit. 

[spoiler]He is one of the Eleven Children who grew up under Eleki Island. 

At some point after escaping, he joined the HCU, and was tutored by [url=/c163251]Nakategawa Morichika[/url]. 

He became part of the investigation into the trafficking of children for the Euro Maspro project, and tracking down the terrorist Sundance Shot.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from the [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Yoshimitsu_Koshimizu]Wiki[/url]]
